title: Identify the type of expenses and their total value approved for 'October M
question:
Identify the type of expenses and their total value approved for 'October Meeting' event.
Benchmark knowledge evidence: total value refers to SUM(cost); 'October Meeting' is an event name;

auxiliary_raw_evidence_draft.base_sql:
SELECT 
    e.XCL_019 AS expense_type,
    SUM(e.XCL_020) AS total_value
FROM expense e
JOIN budget b ON e.XCL_023 = b.XCL_003
JOIN event ev ON b.XCL_009 = ev.XCL_010
WHERE ev.XCL_011 = 'October Meeting'
  AND e.XCL_021 = 'Approved'
GROUP BY e.XCL_019
